messages:
Maya: Quick sync — planning a small PLG experiment for next month. Core pieces: gated webinar + 40 free credits for attendees, automatic prompt-template push in onboarding, and a benchmark post that calls out starter-token economics vs baseline. Need inbound routing rules and a short runbook for prewarming. Thoughts? @Tom @Aisha :eyes:

Tom: Sounds good. I'd attach the credits when utm_campaign=signalframe_webinar and tag accounts with `cohort=webinar_seed`. Rate-limit the credits redemption to 1 per account. Also want a canary so we don't overspend.

Aisha: Messaging POV — keep webinar hook tight: "Build an LLM feature in 10 mins" and emphasize the starter prompt templates as the immediate win. For the benchmark post, headline should be specific: tokens saved + latency delta. I can draft 2 variants (short vs narrative). :sparkles:

Ken: Measurement: define activation as "first meaningful completion within 10 minutes" and track tokens_used in first 3 sessions. We can create an Amplitude cohort `webinar_40` and expose a dashboard. For routing — send credits to signups with `utm_source=signalframe` and new users from the webinar landing only.

Priya: I'll own landing + email. Suggest UTM pattern: `?utm_source=signalframe&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=signalframe_sparkcredits` so analytics is clean. Draft subject ideas: "Join our live build + grab 40 free credits" and "Starter prompts to ship faster".

Liam: Ops checklist: prewarm inference pool 30 mins before start, set burst capacity to +25% for first hour, and add fallback to the quantized variant if queue > 80 requests. Also need a short runbook for handoff to oncall.

DeployBot: infra:prewarm job scheduled for 2026-04-12T09:00:00Z — will trigger pool warmup and scale policy. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/webinar-prewarm (private). :robot_face:

Maya: Love it — action items summarized: Aisha = copy + 2 variants, Tom = routing rule + cohort tag, Ken = analytics dashboard + event spec, Priya = landing + email, Liam = prewarm runbook. Can everyone drop final drafts by EOD Friday? Quick sync Monday AM to confirm rollout. :rocket:

Tom: Dropping the routing pseudo rule here for review: `if utm_campaign == 'signalframe_webinar' and account.age_hours < 24: grant_credits(40, tag='webinar_40') else: no_credit`. Thoughts?

Ken: That rule is fine. Also add dedupe by email_hash to avoid duplicate redemptions.

Aisha: I'll post the copy draft to the content thread later today and ping this thread.

Priya: Landing draft will include the prompt template CTA and a small code snippet users can copy into their workspace — will include a short explainer about token cost savings.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks team — we'll keep the benchmark narrative tight and numbers-first. Follow-ups in the content and analytics threads. :handshake:
